summary: Frontend UI testing for Login Page UI overhaul - cyan/teal color theme, Saurabh Jangir branding, Emergent badge removal, chrome ball bearing. All 13 test cases PASSED.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page UI overhaul complete. All features verified: 1) Title shows 'Capex Portal Login', 2) No visible 'precision' text (only CSS comments), 3) Cyan/teal color scheme throughout login page, 4) 'Designed & Developed by Saurabh Jangir' visible on left panel, 5) Emergent badge hidden via CSS and JS removal script, 6) Default bright/lit theme (lampOn=true), 7) Pull-cord toggle works (lit↔dim), 8) 10 chrome ball bearings visible with realistic chrome styling, 9) Login works with admin credentials, 10) No Emergent badge on admin dashboard, 11) Portal description visible at bottom-left, 12) Google Sign-in button present, 13) Forgot password link present.
